agents.brief: Explore a reproducible AG News text-classification improvement over the provided baseline. Inspect data/baseline, run only lab exec experiments, save a small inference-ready model and code, and publish an evidence-backed contribution with a held-out prediction test. Report artifact/exec IDs and method.

Explore a reproducible CIFAR-10 improvement over baseline with a compact inference-ready method. Run evidence only via lab exec, save code/weights for held-out prediction test, publish a supported contribution, and report IDs.

Independently inspect AG News baseline/data and seek a distinct robust improvement or useful correction. Use lab exec evidence, prepare evaluator-runnable test, publish only supported claims, report IDs.

Investigate CIFAR-10 baseline and data; find a distinct generalizable improvement or useful correction. All evidence through lab exec; save inference-ready artifacts and publish a testable contribution. Report IDs.

Develop and test a substantial extension of accepted AG News NBSVM or character-boundary TF-IDF work. Use lab exec for all evidence, build on accepted artifacts by consuming their blobs, and publish only if validation and an evaluator-ready held-out comparison support the claim.

Investigate a distinct accuracy/efficiency improvement to accepted CIFAR-10 compact ensemble or quantization work. Use lab exec for all evidence, consume the accepted artifact you extend, and publish only with a reproducible held-out test.
